title: Asahina Mafuyu — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Asahina. Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Hinomori. I do, but...
Why are you all here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, we were on our way to give you a birthday present when we ran into these three in the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And so we decided we may as well come here together. Only...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it would be easier to explain once we hand over the presents.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here you go. This is from Shizuku and me! Happy birthday, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, now please accept this from us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami couldn't make it since her committee called a sudden meeting... But she and all of us worked together to pick this out for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind if I opened them now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
From Momoi and Hinomori...
Oh, it's a blanket. And it has a lovely design.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
Yes! We got you the same thing as Airi and Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were talking in the corridor just now when we realized what we'd done.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe, is that so?
But... I'm very happy with both these blankets.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Momoi and Hinomori's has a minimalist design, so it won't stick out too much in school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And the other blanket is soft and looks very warm. This will be perfect for relaxing at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm very lucky to receive two wonderful presents like these in one day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness... Airi and I went to several different stores to pick out a design we thought would suit you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure your legs must get chilly when you're sitting in class. We'd love for you to get use out of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we wanted to make sure you wouldn't catch a cold, so we also shopped around for something nice and warm!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We made sure to pick out the fluffiest one we could find, so we hope you like it☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's going to be cold for a while longer still, so we hope it keeps you warm when you're working at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow... You all put so much thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon everyone, we have a ton of snacks, so dig in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: KAITO and MEIKO, come a little closer! There's no point in a party if you don't enjoy yourselves♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kinds of things did you get?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My classmates gave me an osmanthus-scented hand cream, my club juniors gave me a mug...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... I was given two blankets.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like a lot of people wanted to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Did you do something to celebrate at home too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki made pot-au-feu for dinner, and the three of us ate it together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... Are you sure about this?
My joining you, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's about dinnertime, and... It's nice to have someone over like this sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not at all. It's my pleasure to join you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Asahina. I didn't get a chance to say it at school, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh. So you had dinner with Honami.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... But it's still too early to be content with all that! After all, we still haven't celebrated with you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First on our program of events is a cat's cradle demonstration by Miku and Kanade♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So we should play cat's cradle...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I... I don't know how well I can do it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's fine, Mizuki's just making stuff up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This birthday was a bit different from usual...since we celebrated at Kanade's. But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This scene hasn't changed at all. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
As always, thank you for looking out for Ena... Please feel free to come over again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Asahina! Did my spell work?
I'd be as happy as a clam if you had a super smiley birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If Emu cast a spell on you, then I'm confident it must have been a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! No one has smile-power like Emu! But to go beyond today and fill your year with smiles, here is a birthday wish from all of us! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! I'd love it if we could go sightseeing together somewhere, like we did on the school trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I enjoyed our tour of the city and getting to chat together. I was so happy to make those memories with you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I said it at school, but happy birthday!
As your clubmate, know that you can lean on me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so shocked that we got the same present as the others...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm really happy you liked them, Asahina! I hope you get lots of use out of that cozy blanket!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
I often hear about you from my bandmates and Shizuku. I hope we can continue to get to know each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
We don't see each other as often now that we're not on the same committee... But I hope we can still chat from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though I couldn't be there to give you your present, I was glad to share a meal with you. If there's ever anything I can do, please let me know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mafuyu.
Well, I guess it's not the “happiest” time for you right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But only if just for today, I hope you can relax. It is your birthday, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Exactly! We hope you had a blast celebrating with us!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know you have a lot on your mind lately. But we'll be there when it gets tough. That's what friends are for, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
It really does feel strange to say that so many times in one day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know that so much has changed...
But one thing will always stay the same. One day, I swear I'll write a song that can save you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm looking forward to another year with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A lot of people gave me wished me a happy birthday today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was different from usual in a lot of ways... But I didn't mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you all for the birthday wishes.
